Medium Affected: AIR

Report Description
/// UPDATE TO NRC # 1175351/// /// THIS IS A 48-HOUR UPDATE UNDER PHMSA REGULATIONS /// CALLER UPDATED THAT A TOTAL OF 30 CUSTOMERS WERE EFFECTED. THEY CLOSED THE GAS MAIN VALVES SERVICE TO THOSE CUSTOMERS, CREWS ARE ON LOCATION TO START THE RESTORATION TO THOSE CUSTOMERS. ORIGINAL REPORT # 1175351 NATURAL GAS RELEASED FROM A 4" MEDIUM PRESSURE STEEL GAS MAIN SERVICE PIPELINE TO A COMMERCIAL BUILDING, DUE TO UNKNOWN CAUSES. A FIRE IGNITED AS A RESULT OF THE RELEASE; EXTINGUISHED AT 1532EDT. AT 1508EDT, THE GAS MAIN WAS SHUT-DOWN AND HAS EFFECTED 20 CUSTOMERS (ALL COMMERCIAL). TWO BUILDINGS HAVE BEEN EVACUATED (HEAD COUNT UNKNOWN). NO INJURIES REPORTED.
